name: BTC vs ETH Rolling Volatility Compression Analysis
description: Compares BTC and ETH rolling 30-day realized volatility (annualized std dev of daily log returns, sqrt(252) * rolling_std(30)). Cross-sectional summary table shows current vol, avg vol, min vol floor, vol 90 days ago, and percentile rank. CS lines chart overlays both assets' rolling vol over time. Per-asset xy_lines shows vol with 90-day SMA trend. Per-asset histogram shows vol distribution with analytics. Designed to identify which asset's volatility is compressing faster heading into 2026.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC vs ETH ROLLING VOLATILITY COMPRESSION ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Rolling 30-day realized vol = sqrt(252) * stddev(log_returns, 30)
# Focus: which asset's vol is compressing faster heading into 2026
# =============================================================================

# --- Per-Asset Data (binds to current asset: BTC or ETH) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# Daily log returns
log_ret = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.log)(close)

# Rolling 30-day realized volatility (annualized)
rolling_vol = sqrt(252) * stddev(period=30)(log_ret)

# 90-day SMA of vol to show trend direction
vol_ma90 = ma(period=90)(rolling_vol)

# --- Summary Metrics ---

# Current vol percentile rank vs expanding history
vol_pctrank = percentrank(period=504)(rolling_vol)

# Vol from 90 days ago (to measure compression direction)
vol_90d_ago = rolling_vol >> 90

# Expanding min vol (compression floor)
vol_min = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Min)(rolling_vol)

# Expanding mean vol
vol_avg = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(rolling_vol)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Cross-Sectional Summary Table: key vol metrics side-by-side ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='Volatility Compression Dashboard',
    category='Vol Comparison',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=0,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Volatility Compression Dashboard',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Current 30d Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Vol (Period)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Min Vol (Floor)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol 90d Ago', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Vol Percentile', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    )
)(rolling_vol, vol_avg, vol_min, vol_90d_ago, vol_pctrank)

# --- 2. CS Lines: BTC and ETH rolling 30d vol overlaid ---
cs_lines(
    title='BTC vs ETH: 30-Day Realized Volatility',
    category='Vol Comparison',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Realized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=rolling_vol)

# --- 3. Per-Asset: Rolling Vol + 90d MA Trend ---
xy_lines(
    title='30-Day Realized Vol with 90-Day Trend',
    category='Vol Trend',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Realized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='30d Realized Vol', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='90d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(rolling_vol, vol_ma90))

# --- 4. Per-Asset: Vol Distribution Histogram ---
histogram(
    title='Realized Vol Distribution',
    category='Vol Trend',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Annualized Realized Vol',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.6,
    show_analytics=True,
    order=1
)(value=rolling_vol)
